name: pending-changes
description: Copilot-style review of the files Claude changes: a tree of changed files with +/- counts, accept/reject per file, folder or all, and a VS Code diff to revert single blocks.

persistAcrossSessions.title: Keep pending changes across sessions
persistAcrossSessions.description: Keep the review list, and the originals it diffs against, per git worktree, shared by every session working in it.

openOnStart.title: Open the pane at session start
openOnStart.description: auto opens the pane when files are pending at session start; toast only says so.
